Did anti-Indian racist remarks become a political liability in the 2026 US Midterm Elections?
Republican candidate Bo French, who sparked widespread controversy over his social media posts targeting Indian-American and South Asian students at the University of Texas at Austin, has lost the Texas Railroad Commissioner election to Democrat Jon Rosenthal.
